offer.text: They say you can see the whole world from the high peaks. Climb the mountains and let me live it through your eyes.

accept.text: Pack warm and tread careful. The heights are no joke.

decline.text: The summit waits for braver boots, then.

in_progress.text: Have you reached the high country yet?

ready.text: You stood above the clouds! I can see it in your eyes. Magnificent.

complete.text: One day I'll make that climb myself. Until then — well earned.
